name: UI：策略详情-新增节点/节点类型选择验证
description: 验证策略详情页：+新增节点按钮→节点类型选择面板→20种节点类型文案完整性

steps.expression: (() => { const addBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a, [class*=addNode]')).find(el => el.textContent.includes('新增节点') || el.textContent.includes('+')); if(addBtn) { addBtn.click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'not found'; })()

(() => { const nodeTypes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=nodeType], [class*=node-type], .ant-list-item, [class*=nodeCard]')).map(el => el.textContent.trim().substring(0, 30)); return { nodeTypes, count: nodeTypes.length }; })()

_testDesign.realDomNotes: 20种节点类型：LLM文本生成/生图/Map生图/季节标签/产业标签/定价节点/模板匹配/人工审核/推送选款/面料上身/款式分配/匹配度打分/图像裁头/改款prompt推理/Caption/机审/视频生成/视频上传/高清化处理/选片。
riskPoints: 节点类型面板可能为弹窗/侧边栏/下拉
